newsitem.title: UK: BFI down four, Panamaxes seen stabilising.
newsitem.headline: BFI down four, Panamaxes seen stabilising.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was down four points to 1,283 points on Wednesday with brokers reporting a levelling-out in Panamax rates both in the east and west.

Navios were reported to have fixed 54,000 heavy grain from US Gulf to Japan for Aug 15/20 at $22.00 no combo and brokers believed that potentially increased grain chartering activity from the North Pacific will now stabilise the market.
Caper rates in the east have remained weak for early ships and barely steady in the Atlantic while Handy-size levels in the Atlantic remained in the doldrums.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was unchanged to 10 points lower and turnover was seven lots.
